scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Mapping validates control totals and adjustments
assertions: control totals and adjustment semantics are validated
reversals and replacements are treated as separate transaction semantics

scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Reject counting the same expense again
assertions: the same expense is not counted again

scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Reject approval of unbalanced source totals
assertions: approval is blocked unless an explicit permitted exception is recorded

scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Show unspent budget and forecast overrun as separate facts
assertions: it shows 40 currently unspent
it shows a forecast overrun of ten as a separate fact
the sign convention is labelled

scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Forecast assumptions recorded separately
assertions: its assumptions and author or method version are recorded separately from actuals

scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Reject treating missing spending as underspend
assertions: the missing data is not shown as underspend

scenarios.source_scenario: Scenario: Reject forecasts entering actual expenditure
assertions: the forecast does not enter the actual expenditure series
it does not imply programme impact success

scenarios.source_scenario: Capture baseline metrics per priority problem
assertions: time, cost, quality and reach are captured for that problem

scenarios.source_scenario: Lock the baseline with a date
assertions: the baseline is locked and the lock date is recorded

scenarios.source_scenario: Reject changes to a locked baseline
assertions: the edit is refused

scenarios.source_scenario: Reject locking an incomplete baseline
assertions: the lock is refused

scenarios.source_scenario: Inspect effective access
assertions: each permitted grant path, restriction and missing assurance is shown

scenarios.source_scenario: Explain a normal user's own access
assertions: they see explanations only about their own permitted context

scenarios.source_scenario: Resolve conflicting roles
assertions: the restriction remains effective
the explanation identifies the scope rule safely

scenarios.source_scenario: Reject leaking hidden information
assertions: names of hidden projects and sensitive field values are not exposed
the out of scope simulation is refused
